experiment_data.hypothesis: Adaptive Conformal CRM with τ=0.15 (lower threshold → higher trigger rate) on SmolVLA LIBERO-Object should yield higher trigger rate than τ=0.25 spatial sweep (~5%) while improving over CRM-always (K=2, ε=0.05) baseline. Tests whether SmolVLA's Object suite benefits from more frequent uncertainty-gated corrections than Spatial.
